articles.title: Workshop meeting links
articles.answer: The Google Meet link is included in the event confirmation and reminder. Please check the email address used to register and the event page before the workshop begins.

articles.title: Viungo vya mikutano ya warsha
articles.answer: Kiungo cha Google Meet kinapatikana kwenye ujumbe wa kuthibitisha usajili na ukumbusho wa tukio. Tafadhali angalia barua pepe uliyotumia kujisajili na ukurasa wa tukio kabla ya warsha kuanza.

articles.title: Liens de réunion des ateliers
articles.answer: Le lien Google Meet figure dans la confirmation d’inscription et le rappel de l’événement. Vérifiez l’adresse e-mail utilisée lors de l’inscription et la page de l’événement avant le début de l’atelier.

articles.title: Workshop registration
articles.answer: Register through the official event page. A successful registration produces a confirmation message; submitting the form alone does not guarantee a place when capacity is limited.

articles.title: Usajili wa warsha
articles.answer: Jisajili kupitia ukurasa rasmi wa tukio. Usajili uliofanikiwa hutoa ujumbe wa uthibitisho; kujaza fomu pekee hakuhakikishi nafasi ikiwa idadi ya washiriki ni ndogo.

articles.title: Inscription aux ateliers
articles.answer: Inscrivez-vous sur la page officielle de l’événement. Une inscription réussie génère une confirmation; l’envoi du formulaire seul ne garantit pas une place si la capacité est limitée.

articles.title: Workshop participation records
articles.answer: Any participation record offered for a workshop will be described on that event’s page. Do not assume a certificate is included unless the event details explicitly say so.

articles.title: Rekodi za kushiriki warsha
articles.answer: Rekodi yoyote ya ushiriki inayotolewa itaelezwa kwenye ukurasa wa tukio. Usidhani kuwa cheti kinatolewa isipokuwa maelezo ya tukio yaseme hivyo wazi.

articles.title: Justificatifs de participation
articles.answer: Tout justificatif de participation proposé sera indiqué sur la page de l’événement. Ne supposez pas qu’un certificat est inclus sauf si les détails de l’événement le précisent clairement.
